name: Central Data Systems
summary: West Perth ISP and data centre operator; built ISP/data centre infrastructure 1995 (early IP block registered as SATIX, 1997 APNIC); AS18065; WAIX participant as 'Central Data' (2007); ISP arm wound down, now cloud computing/IT consultancy (CENTRAL DATA SYSTEMS PTY LTD, ACN 120 156 185).

events.details: Company's own history claims a 1983 founding as an IT consultancy (unverified, and predating the current incorporated entity); built ISP/data centre infrastructure 1995; IP block 203.132.96.0-127 registered as SATIX (1997 APNIC); AS18065 (CENTRAL-AS-AP) registered to Central Data System Pty Ltd; 88 Havelock St, West Perth WA 6005. The ACN 120 156 185 entity (CENTRAL DATA SYSTEMS PTY LTD) was only registered 19 Jun 2006, so it post-dates the ISP infrastructure and is either a re-incorporation or a later same-name vehicle.
ISP services wound down; company continues as cloud computing and IT consultancy (QV.1 data centre, GoPC.net cloud platform).
